method: 24 paired seeds in each predeclared regime. Intervals are 2,000 resamples of paired primary-outcome differences. Null values are excluded from numeric aggregates and retain explicit valid counts. No biological or physical validation is implied.

regimes.label: Before the asteroid
regimes.description: Clustered deposits, no fault: redundancy has overhead even when it is never used.

regimes.label: Separate failures
regimes.description: Bodies fail independently with probability one half. The whole initial budget remains matched.

regimes.label: One shared scar
regimes.description: A single spatial damage field strikes bodies together. More nodes do not imply more independent survival chances.

regimes.label: The asteroid button
regimes.description: Body loss, 90% remaining resource loss, corrupted sensors, blackout and rubble arrive together.

regimes.label: Radio silence
regimes.description: Only communication fails. Existing local plans and observations remain available.

regimes.label: The missing deposits
regimes.description: Remove 90% of remaining material, leaving bodies and links healthy.

regimes.label: Unreliable eyes
regimes.description: Corrupt local observations while retaining intact bodies, material and links.

regimes.label: A road becomes a wall
regimes.description: One new physical barrier tests the frozen contact-detour policy alone.
